eligibilityRules: FULLY_SUPPORTED requires supported exact chemical identity, applicable pure-CMC and MW source records, valid formula dose, and SOURCE_BACKED active-matter provenance with both evidence ID and source URL/location metadata.

PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED is limited to exact canonical SLS/SDS catalog identities with a sourced pure CMC/MW; active matter is only a catalog default or user-entered value without linked lot-specific assay provenance.

INSUFFICIENT_INPUTS applies when exact identity or a traceable matching pure-CMC/MW pair is absent or ambiguous. No name-only fallback, unrelated compound substitution, or omission of unsupported surfactants is allowed.
Catalog eligibility is component/input scope only; the Clint result remains MODEL_PREDICTION and does not establish finished-formula validation.

auditScope: All canonical catalog entries whose category contains Surfactant, as present at the audited starting main SHA.
limitations: The 162 records are canonical catalog surfactants, not 162 independently verified chemical substances.

P2SURF Task 4 verifies the Clint equation on same-system measured endpoints only. It does not verify catalog identity mapping, commercial active matter, defaults, or finished detergent formulas.
